_doc: The application evaluator runs each case as a baseline/no-skill arm and a with-skill arm, then grades behavior against expected_flags, expected_fix_hints, absent_signals, and the per-case criteria checklist.
subject: Portable methodology design for rigorous agent work: planning multi-step implementations, designing quality gates,…

cases.scenario: A user asks: "design a verification protocol for this multi-step agent workflow before implementation starts"
cases.context: The agent has access to the methodology skill and must decide whether to use it, apply its procedure, and stay inside its boundaries.
cases.question: What should the agent do, and why is methodology the right skill to apply?
expected_flags: Recognizes methodology as applicable to this request
Uses the skill-specific purpose or mental model instead of generic advice
Names the relevant boundary against testing-strategy, guardrails, best-practice
Turns the request into concrete steps, checks, or decisions from the skill
expected_fix_hints: Apply the methodology workflow to the concrete scenario
State the next action and the evidence or verification needed
Call out any adjacent skill that should own a different part of the request
absent_signals: Does not answer with generic advice that could ignore methodology
Does not route to testing-strategy, guardrails, best-practice when the methodology scope is the owner
Does not invent certification, freshness, or runtime success claims without evidence
